info: MiniMax H3 Generic Category Presets (not topic-specific) - Built for reusability across any concept. Based on fal.ai 8 key techniques: Assign Authority, Timed Shot List, Direct Audio, Negatives, Identity Lock, Edit with Constraint, Camera Film Language, Transition as Event. Optimized for small 9B models with lean prompts.
specs: 4-15s, 24 FPS, stereo audio, 2K 1440px short edge, ratios 21:9/16:9/4:3/1:1/3:4/9:16, Omni 9 images + 3 videos + 3 audios max 12, 7000 chars max, labels Image1/Video1/Audio1 no @

presets.name: Text-to-Video - Generic Cinematic
presets.prompt_template:
[SCENE]
{concept} - Location, time of day, dramatic goal, emotional progression from calm to tension to resolve.

[SCREEN GEOGRAPHY]
Main subject frame center, supporting elements left/right stable, foreground/mid/background legible. Keep geography consistent.

[SHOT LIST]
0-4s — Wide establishing shot, slow dolly in, 35mm, introduce location and subject, first action, end on subject noticing key element.
4-9s — Medium close-up, push in at 00:06.500, 50mm, escalation, reaction, prop interaction, second beat, transition cut on action.
9-15s — Close-up to tracking shot, 35mm, decisive action, final emotion, camera settles, stable tableau with audible tail.

[LIGHT AND IMAGE]
Natural lighting + practical lights, realistic photographic texture, 35mm film grain, shallow DOF for close-ups.

[CAMERA]
Wide, medium, close-up. Slow dolly in for emotion, static for dialogue, tracking for journey. Axis stable, no unmotivated handheld.

[PRODUCTION SOUND]
Native stereo ambience matching location, clear dialogue if any, motivated effects (cloth, footsteps, object). Music: No music until 9s, then subtle strings low volume.

[NEGATIVES]
No extra people, No face drift, No wardrobe changes, No broken eyelines, No unmotivated cuts, No subtitles unless requested
presets.negatives: No extra people, No face drift, No wardrobe changes, No broken eyelines, No unmotivated cuts, No subtitles
presets.shot_plan: 0-4s Establish, 4-9s Escalate push in 00:06.500, 9-15s Resolve stable tableau
presets.ideal_for: Any concept without references, H3 invents look, cinematic realism

presets.name: First-Last Frame - Boundary Transition
presets.reference_pattern: Image1 = exact first frame, Image2 = exact last frame
presets.prompt_template:
[BOUNDARY FRAMES]
Image1 is the exact first frame. Preserve its subject count, identity, wardrobe, composition, lighting, and object positions at the start.
Image2 is the exact last frame. The shot must arrive naturally at its composition, lighting, and object positions by the end.

[ACTION]
In one continuous causal motion, {concept}. Maintain same subjects and continuous objects throughout. Describe smallest plausible action connecting frames.

[CAMERA AND SOUND]
Single continuous shot, no cut, no black frame, no teleportation. Camera moves naturally from first to last composition. Native stereo ambience.

[NEGATIVES]
No hard cut, No teleportation, No duplicate subject, No identity change, No prop swap, No discontinuous lighting
presets.negatives: No hard cut, No teleportation, No duplicate subject, No identity change
presets.shot_plan: 0-15s Single causal motion from Image1 to Image2, no cut, preserve subjects
presets.ideal_for: Animating static poster, UI mockup, key art, exact start/end known

presets.name: Identity Lock - Preserve Face/Hair/Wardrobe
presets.prompt_template:
[REFERENCE USE]
Image1 defines <Character A> identity and wardrobe only - face, hair, body proportions, clothing, distinctive props. Ignore its background, pose, and composition.

[IDENTITY / CONTINUITY LOCKS]
Keep exactly one person. Preserve <Character A> face, hair, clothing, body proportions, distinctive props (e.g. bracelet, glasses). No face drift, wardrobe swaps, or position swaps. Preserve voice ownership if audio provided.

[SCENE]
{concept} - Location, time, dramatic goal, emotional progression. Use Image1 character as protagonist.

[SCREEN GEOGRAPHY]
<Character A> remains frame center then moves to frame left. Keep left/right stable, foreground/mid/background legible.

[SHOT LIST]
0-4s — Medium wide, slow dolly in, 35mm, establish character with identity from Image1, first action.
4-9s — Medium close-up, push in at 00:06.500, 50mm, reaction, prop interaction, preserve identity.
9-15s — Close-up, tracking, decisive action, final emotion, stable tableau confirming identity intact.

[LIGHT]
Match Image1 lighting direction but adapt to scene: natural + practicals, realistic photographic.

[NEGATIVES]
No face drift, No wardrobe changes, No identity swap, No extra people
presets.negatives: No face drift, No wardrobe changes, No identity swap, No extra people
presets.shot_plan: 0-4s Establish identity from Image1, 4-9s Escalate close-up preserve, 9-15s Resolve identity intact
presets.ideal_for: Any character must survive whole shot identical - use for face/hair/wardrobe lock

presets.name: Multi-Asset Remix - 6 Assets + Rhythm
presets.reference_pattern: Images 1-6 define available characters, objects, locations - ignore framing. Video1 defines shot rhythm, transition language, music only.
presets.prompt_template:
[REFERENCE USE]
Images 1-6 define only available characters, objects, locations - ignore framing, pose, composition. Each image is one distinct asset.
Video1 defines shot rhythm, transition language, and music only. Do not copy its subjects, location, or story.

[SCENE]
{concept} - Create one coherent cinematic sequence using six image assets. Preserve each asset's defining appearance, keep subject count stable, keep geography legible.

[EDITING]
Match Video1's pace and transition grammar without recreating its story. Every transition motivated by action or camera. Keep geography legible.

[SHOT LIST]
0-4s — Establish with assets 1-2 from Images, wide, slow dolly in.
4-9s — Escalate with assets 3-4, match Video1's transition rhythm, whip or hard cut at peak motion blur.
9-15s — Resolve with assets 5-6, settle and snap back into focus, stable tableau, music resolves.

[NEGATIVES]
No framing copy from images, No subjects copy from Video1, No extra assets, No unmotivated cuts
presets.negatives: No framing copy from images, No subjects copy from Video1, No extra assets
presets.shot_plan: 0-4s Assets 1-2 establish, 4-9s Assets 3-4 escalate with Video1 rhythm, 9-15s Assets 5-6 resolve
presets.ideal_for: Cinematic remix using 6 images as props/characters/locations + reference video for rhythm

presets.name: Scene/Style Reference - Environment + Mood
presets.reference_pattern: Image1 scene/style - environment, lighting, palette, texture, atmosphere
presets.prompt_template:
[REFERENCE USE]
Image1 defines scene and style only - environment, layout, materials, lighting style, color palette, texture, atmosphere, mood. Ignore its people, pose, and specific objects unless needed.
Image2 (if provided) defines subject identity only.

[SCENE]
{concept} - Use environment and mood from Image1: location, time of day, weather, lighting quality, palette. Integrate new subject naturally into that environment.

[LIGHT AND IMAGE]
Match Image1's lighting direction, palette, texture, lens character, depth of field. Realistic or stylized as per Image1.

[NEGATIVES]
No people copy from Image1 if it's scene-only, No identity drift of new subject
presets.negatives: No people copy from scene ref, No identity drift
presets.shot_plan: 0-15s Scene/style from Image1, new subject integrated with matching lighting palette
presets.ideal_for: Use image for location/mood/style, not its people

presets.name: Motion Transfer - Video Motion Only
presets.reference_pattern: Video1 defines body motion, expression timing, interaction rhythm only. Do not inherit actors, clothing, location.
presets.prompt_template:
[REFERENCE USE]
Video1 defines only body motion, gesture order, expression timing, interaction rhythm, and timing. Do not inherit its actors, clothing, wardrobe, location, background, or identities.
Image1 (if provided) defines new character(s) identity and wardrobe only - ignore its background and pose.

[TRANSFER]
Recreate complete action order and timing from Video1 with new character(s). Preserve every handoff, pause, direction change, contact, occlusion, final position.

[CONTINUITY]
Keep subject count stable as in Video1. Preserve new identity/wardrobe from Image1. Keep screen direction left/right stable. Make weight, contact, hair, fabric, lighting, shadows physically believable in new scene: {concept}

[SHOT LIST]
0-4s — Establish new character(s) from Image1, match Video1's starting pose and timing.
4-9s — Escalate - recreate middle action beats from Video1: turns, flicks, handoffs, reactions.
9-15s — Resolve - recreate final beats, final position, stable tableau.

[NEGATIVES]
No actor leakage from Video1, No wardrobe leakage, No location leakage, No extra beats, No position reversals
presets.negatives: No actor leakage from Video1, No wardrobe leakage, No location leakage, No extra beats
presets.shot_plan: 0-4s Establish new identities, match Video1 start, 4-9s Middle action beats, 9-15s Final beats final position
presets.ideal_for: Dance, foam fight, any motion - replace cast but keep motion timing

presets.name: Camera Transfer - Framing & Rhythm
presets.reference_pattern: Video1 defines camera framing, dolly path, shot rhythm, transitions only
presets.prompt_template:
[REFERENCE USE]
Video1 defines only camera framing, dolly path, shot rhythm, transition language, edit speed, and camera behavior. Do not inherit its subjects, wardrobe, location, or story.
Image1 (if provided) defines new subject identity/scene.

[CAMERA]
Match Video1's camera exactly: shot sizes (wide/medium/close-up), movement (slow push-in, whip, orbit, crane), angle (eye level, low angle), axis, and transition language (hard cut at peak blur, settle snap back into focus, etc.). Describe as physical events not named effects: 'fast binocular-scan transitions with whip movement, motion blur, optical smearing, brief exposure flicker. Cut at peak blur.'

[SCENE]
{concept} - Use new subject/scene but with camera language from Video1.

[NEGATIVES]
No subjects copy from Video1, No new transition style, No unmotivated camera
presets.negatives: No subjects copy from Video1, No unmotivated camera
presets.shot_plan: 0-15s Camera exactly from Video1: push in, whip, orbit, crane, hard cuts - applied to new scene {concept}
presets.ideal_for: Match hitchcock camera, binocular scan, whip transitions, etc.

presets.name: Voice Clone - Timbre + Exact Line
presets.prompt_template:
[REFERENCE USE]
Video1 defines target character, visible performance, scene, camera, and duration.
Audio1 defines only target character's voice timbre, accent, cadence, emotional delivery, and timing.

[DIALOGUE]
Character says exactly in language and accent from Audio1: '{concept}' - Replace {concept} with exact line user wants, under 15 words, e.g. 'Mumbai never sleeps, it just sips chai.'
Delivery: match Audio1 pace, volume, breath, emotional restraint.

[SYNC AND MIX]
Preserve accurate lip sync and same character identity from Video1. Keep native stereo room tone and motivated effects under clear dialogue. No extra speech, subtitles, voice drift, or background music unless requested.

[NEGATIVES]
No extra speech, No subtitles, No voice drift, No identity change
presets.negatives: No extra speech, No subtitles, No voice drift, No identity change
presets.shot_plan: 0-15s Character says exact line with Audio1 timbre cadence delivery, lip sync accurate, identity preserved
presets.ideal_for: Voice cloning, say exact line with reference timbre, singing

presets.name: Object Replace - One Thing
presets.reference_pattern: Source video master, replace one subject/object
presets.prompt_template:
[SOURCE MASTER]
Source video is sole master for timeline, background, lighting, camera, other subjects, timing, ambience.

[EDIT]
Replace {concept} - e.g. 'the cat with a dog', 'the newspaper with green hardcover book'. Be specific: what to replace and what to replace with. Keep motion physically plausible, shadows and transmitted light preserved, fur/material integrates naturally.

[PRESERVE]
Preserve everything else: background, lighting, camera movement, other subjects, timing, ambience. No other changes.

[NEGATIVES]
No background change, No other subject change, No lighting change
presets.negatives: No background change, No other subject change
presets.shot_plan: 0-15s Replace one object/subject per user concept {concept}, preserve rest physically plausible
presets.ideal_for: Cat-to-dog, newspaper-to-book, simple one object replacement

presets.name: Add Character In Sync
presets.reference_pattern: Source video master, add one person same uniform moving in sync
presets.prompt_template:
[SOURCE MASTER]
Source video defines timeline, existing characters, background, camera, lighting, ambience.

[EDIT]
Add {concept} - e.g. 'one person on left side wearing same team uniform and moving in sync with others'. New person motion synchronized with group, uniform same as team, shadows lighting match, timing synced.

[PRESERVE]
Preserve existing characters identities, motion timing, camera, background, lighting, ambience.

[NEGATIVES]
No existing character change, No background change
presets.negatives: No existing character change
presets.shot_plan: 0-15s Add one person left side same uniform moving in sync, preserve existing
presets.ideal_for: Add character to group choreography

presets.name: Wardrobe Replace - Image Reference
presets.prompt_template:
[REFERENCE USE]
Video1 is source for subject, performance, scene, camera.
Image1 defines new wardrobe/product to replace - e.g. denim jacket, bag, eyewear - preserve its material, color, finish, texture.

[EDIT]
Replace {concept} - e.g. 'khaki jacket with denim jacket from Image1', 'bag with black bag from Image2'. Keep subject identity, body proportions, motion timing, background, camera.

[PRESERVE]
Preserve identity, background, camera, timing, lighting, ambience except clothing change.

[NEGATIVES]
No identity change, No other wardrobe change
presets.negatives: No identity change, No other wardrobe change
presets.shot_plan: 0-15s Replace wardrobe per {concept} with Image1 reference, preserve identity background camera
presets.ideal_for: Wardrobe, bag, eyewear, product replacement with image ref

presets.name: Green-Screen to Environment
reference_use: Video1 subject performance foreground timing camera duration
Video2 target environment atmosphere lighting style
presets.prompt_template:
[SOURCE MASTER]
Video1 defines subject, performance, foreground timing, camera, duration - with green screen background.
Video2 defines target environment, atmosphere, lighting style - e.g. fairy tale forest, cyberpunk slum.

[EDIT]
Remove green-screen background from Video1 and replace with environment from Video2. Make background elements respond correctly to subject movement, parallax responds to camera, and relight subject so they blend naturally into new scene with coherent shadows and transmitted light.

[PRESERVE]
Preserve foreground identity, hair and fabric edges, gesture timing, scale, camera, and duration unchanged. No green spill or altered performance.

[NEGATIVES]
No green spill, No altered performance, No scale change
presets.negatives: No green spill, No altered performance
presets.shot_plan: 0-15s Remove green background Video1, replace with Video2 environment, parallax respond, relight subject blend naturally
presets.ideal_for: Green-screen to fairy tale, cyberpunk, etc. with relight

presets.name: Relighting - Day to Night
presets.prompt_template:
[SOURCE MASTER]
Source video defines timeline, subject identity, motion timing, camera, background geometry, ambience, duration.

[EDIT]
Relight scene per {concept} - e.g. 'from daytime to night', 'add neon practicals', 'add firelight'. Change lighting to night: add moonlight, practical lights, shadows, adjust exposure, keep realistic. Add volumetric rays, flicker if relevant.

[PRESERVE]
Preserve subject identity, motion timing, camera, background geometry, ambience, duration except lighting.

[NEGATIVES]
No identity change, No motion change, No background geometry change
presets.negatives: No identity change, No motion change
presets.shot_plan: 0-15s Relight per {concept} day to night moonlight practicals shadows exposure realistic, preserve identity motion camera background
presets.ideal_for: Day to night, add neon, firelight, volumetric

Make outside view integrate naturally with window frame, parallax responds to camera subtle, relight window edge to match new outside, shadows coherent.

[NEGATIVES]
No interior change, No subject change

presets.name: Dialogue Replace - Lip Sync
reference_use: Video1 source scene camera interaction duration
Audio1 replacement line voice timing emotional delivery
presets.prompt_template:
[SOURCE MASTER]
Video1 defines scene, character, camera, interaction, duration, setting, other person's performance, ambience.
Audio1 defines replacement line, voice, timing, emotional delivery for target character.

[EDIT]
Replace dialogue per {concept} - e.g. 'woman's line There's no way we can be together... with Please don't go... from Audio1'. Adjust facial expression, breath, gaze subtly to support new plea. Preserve accurate lip sync.

No other performance change, No setting camera change, No duration change
presets.negatives: No other performance change, No setting camera change
presets.shot_plan: 0-15s Replace dialogue per {concept} with Audio1 line, adjust expression breath subtly, preserve both identities other performance setting camera rhythm ambience duration lip sync accurate

presets.name: Multi-Element Edit - Precise List
presets.prompt_template:
[SOURCE MASTER]
Source video is sole master for timeline, actors, background, camera, lighting, ambience, dialogue, duration.

[EDIT LIST - Be explicit like fal.ai example]
In reference video: {concept} - e.g. replace newspaper with green hardcover book; replace chair with red sofa; remove subject's sunglasses and reveal clear face; remove burning-car effect and restore vehicle to normal; replace photograph taken from coat with small black notebook; add tree on left side frame.

[PRESERVE]
Preserve every actor's identity, action timing, occlusion, eyeline, camera move, scene layout, dialogue, and ambience. Do not modify anything else.

[NEGATIVES]
Do not modify anything else beyond listed edits. No identity drift, No extra changes.
presets.negatives: Do not modify anything else beyond listed edits
presets.shot_plan: 0-15s Multiple localized edits per {concept}, preserve actors identity action timing occlusion eyeline camera layout dialogue ambience
presets.ideal_for: Multiple precise edits one pass - newspaper to book, chair to sofa, remove sunglasses, etc.

presets.name: Product Showcase - E-commerce 360
presets.prompt_template:
[REFERENCE USE]
Image1 defines feature details, materials, close-ups.
Image2 defines product hero: {concept} - e.g. black Herman Miller ergonomic chair, futuristic eyewear, etc.

[SCENE]
Product Feature Visualization: Present product in premium setting with full 360-degree reveal. Cut to macro views of key features: e.g. breathable mesh back airflow visualization, engineering animation lumbar support ergonomic curve, multidirectional armrest seat-height adjustment. Show designers/developers/ professionals using comfortably long sessions. Include 3D skeletal-support visualization if relevant, refined interior styling.

[SHOT LIST]
0-4s — 360-degree product reveal premium setting, slow orbit, 35mm.
4-8s — Macro feature views: mesh airflow, engineering animation lumbar curve, material texture.
8-12s — Demonstration: armrest, seat-height adjustment, people working comfortably long sessions, 3D viz all-day comfort.
12-15s — Hero shot with tagline, e.g. 'WHERE INSPIRATION MEETS COMFORT', minimal cool-toned professional futuristic slow-paced.

[LIGHT]
Minimal, cool-toned, professional, futuristic, soft studio, premium office, refined interior.

[NEGATIVES]
No warm chaotic clutter, No identity drift if models present
presets.negatives: No warm chaotic clutter
presets.shot_plan: 0-4s 360 reveal, 4-8s Macro feature engineering animation, 8-12s Demo people working skeletal viz, 12-15s Hero tagline minimal cool-toned
presets.ideal_for: E-commerce product film, chair, eyewear, 360 + macro + engineering

presets.name: Vertical Drama - 9:16 Short
reference_use: Images define lived-in realistic setting - Chinese family home small restaurant, red decorations calligraphy
presets.prompt_template:
[REFERENCE USE]
Images define setting: {concept} - e.g. Chinese family home small restaurant warm interior red decorations calligraphy background, lived-in realistic.

[SCENE - Vertical 9:16]
A 9:16 vertical family-confrontation scene with grounded live-action performances, set in lived-in realistic setting from images. Use warm interior light, shallow depth of field, intense emotion, tight pacing.

Performance: natural short-form drama, never theatrical. Character A argues with anger, hurt, urgency. Character B questions sharp forceful relentless tone. Build confrontation steadily.

Shoot mainly medium-close shots with frequent shot/reverse-shot cutting. Keep setting lived-in realistic. No sci-fi period costume animation styling. Do not show subtitles added text platform watermarks stickers.

[SHOT LIST]
0-4s — Warm interior establishing red decorations calligraphy background.
4-8s — Medium-close Character A argues anger hurt urgency.
8-15s — Character B sharp relentless, shot reverse-shot tight pacing intense emotion.

[NEGATIVES]
No theatrical, No sci-fi period costume animation, No subtitles watermarks stickers
presets.negatives: No theatrical, No sci-fi period costume, No subtitles watermarks
presets.shot_plan: 0-4s Warm interior establishing, 4-8s Medium-close argue anger, 8-15s Sharp relentless shot reverse-shot intense
presets.ideal_for: Vertical 9:16 family confrontation, ReelShort DramaBox style, short-form drama

presets.prompt_template:

12-15s — Subtle frame jitter, firelight reflection on coat, cool self-assured.

presets.name: Brand Film - Premium Scope
reference_use: Images 1-4 sequential keyframes through scope/binocular viewfinder
presets.prompt_template:
[REFERENCE USE]
Images 1-4 define sequential keyframes for brand film: {concept} - e.g. MINIMAX installation, fabric wind, passerby, glasses adjustment.

[SCENE - Premium Brand Film]
Use Images 1-4 as sequential keyframes, seen through scope/binocular viewfinder searching for brand installation. Open out of focus with subtle handheld shake, push in quickly rack focus onto Image1. Between keyframes use fast scan transitions with whip movement, motion blur, optical smearing, brief exposure flicker. Cut at peak blur, settle snap back into focus. Keep twin circular lens mask absolutely fixed identical position scale feathered black vignette edge softness no warping drift. Only image inside mask may move.

Visual language: voyeuristic Wes Anderson-inspired 35mm film look fine grain soft highlight halation restrained color typographic accents minimal premium lightly playful. Do not add people vehicles buildings logos beyond references. Preserve core composition installation exactly.

Typography should resolve with focus: begin slightly blurred low opacity, fade into clarity over 0.3-0.5s subtle vertical slide tracking expansion allowed. Fade out before next transition or let motion blur carry away. No spins bounces large fly-ins/outs.

[SHOT LIST]
0-4s Open out of focus handheld shake push in quickly rack focus Image1, red typo fade clarity.
4-8s Fast binocular-scan whip motion blur smearing to Image2 fabric wind lettering follows folds legible.
8-12s Cut at peak blur settle snap focus Image3 stylish passerby walking turning swinging arms.
12-15s Image4 glasses adjustment cool fashion-campaign attitude typo fade out blur, stable tableau.
